learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from security inconclusive verdicts - a failed audit is not the same as an uncertain security assessment
When one model has a tool error on a specific file and another model successfully audits that file, the successful audit should be weighted as complete coverage
The audit tool should track and report tool errors separately from security verdicts to avoid conflating infrastructure failures with security uncertainty
